title: Former Hells Angels president frozen for 10 minutes

tellings.quote: >> the former president of its large chapter of the Hells Angels was there as attending security.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property where strange events are reported and investigated, says a man who had been president of a large chapter of the Hells Angels motorcycle club, working there as security, was frozen in place for about ten minutes behind a building on the ranch called Homestead 3. Fugal tells Michels about it as something that happened on his watch, sometime in the years after 2016. He tells it as a sign that whatever is on the ranch can overpower even a hardened man.
